evidence.source: Development fast-lane rollout run 31100989022, applying contracts 121 and 122 in one run on main at 33bff3a. The lane derived the pending set, proved each migration additive by reading it before applying, took a pre-apply snapshot and confirmed afterwards that hosted development matched the repository. THE FOLLOW-UP OPENED ITS OWN PULL REQUEST THIS TIME — PR #527 — which is the first time that automation has completed unaided: the 6 August contract-120 record was stranded on a branch because the repository forbade GitHub Actions from creating pull requests, and the owner enabled that setting the same day. This record carries the identical content by hand because #527's checks sit in action_required, which is a separate and smaller gap: a bot-authored pull request needs its workflows released before it can merge. WHAT THIS RECORD DOES NOT CLAIM: no object-level hash, grant, RLS or cron assertion was re-derived here. Those belong to the run's own logs and snapshot artifact, and to the pgTAP suites shipped with contracts 121 and 122, both of which executed under Database parity before their merges.
